listing.description_html:
40 friendly dinosaurs are ready for your colors!

Kids ages 4 to 8 can color a mighty T rex, a happy triceratops, a long neck brachiosaurus, flying pterodactyls, baby dinos hatching from eggs and lots of prehistoric adventures. Every page has big, bold lines and simple shapes that are easy to color.

  • 40 unique dinosaur illustrations
  • Single sided pages so markers never bleed onto the next picture
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch format
  • Perfect gift for birthdays, holidays, road trips and quiet time

Screen free fun that builds creativity and fine motor skills. Add it to your cart today!
